rationale: Git Trees/Blobs offer a more primitive and immutable-friendly data model for repository state.
Refining the retrieval abstraction to handle Git-specific objects is a sound architectural evolution.
Massive performance gains by reducing HTTP round-trips and base64 overhead.
Single-call tree discovery allows for more robust declarative path filtering logic.
Enables building more responsive and dynamic repository browsers/explorers.
Accepting architectural drift in exchange for critical UX stability and bandwidth efficiency.

column5: risk of 100k file limit is negligible for current project scope.
